policy: Fill unavailable exact-object fields only; preserve all existing adopted values. Published model/seismic values retain methods and uncertainties. No individual values inferred from blended system light.

* alf Tau.label: Aldebaran
* alf Tau.scope: Exact * alf Tau; individual stellar parameters, never a companion or system total.
* alf Tau.note: Rudrasingam et al. (2026): approximate seismic mass from nu_max and independent radius. Formal source errors omit scaling systematics. Published mass is approximate and inherits seismic-scaling systematics; existing adopted quantities retain their independent sources.

mass_solar.method: Published nu_max scaling using independently measured radius and effective temperature; not a dynamical mass

luminosity_solar.section: Derived here from the coherent Table 1 radius and temperature
luminosity_solar.method: Stefan-Boltzmann; source inputs, not independently adopted mixed-source temperature

luminosity_solar.section: Derived here from Table 7 radius and Teff

mass_solar.section: Table A.1; TYC 1470-1157-1, both resolving powers
mass_solar.method: Published evolutionary mass of the spectroscopically dominant subgiant; not the unseen companion or binary total
mass_solar.caveat: Primary-dominated spectroscopy and model assumptions; both source spectra independently list 1.40 +/-0.41 solar masses.

retainedPreviousSharedReview.label: Muphrid
retainedPreviousSharedReview.scope: Reviewed catalog object/component cns5-3442; aliases only, distinct companions remain separate.
retainedPreviousSharedReview.notes: Corrected CNS5 3442; J2000 Sun-relative Galactic position. SIMBAD exact CNS5 identity. Transverse-only source motion; radial velocity unavailable or withheld. Shared exact-identity physical supplements (temperature_k: 2025A&A...703A.128B; metallicity_dex: 2025A&A...703A.128B). Prefer the frozen 2025 spectroscopic temperature over the 1999 model temperature; retain primary-dominated spectral scope and withhold individual mass, radius, luminosity and age as in the existing reviewed catalogs.

astrometryAndMotion.decision: Retain the curated nearest-catalog coordinate/motion bundle where available; otherwise use the later Western snapshot. For the eleven reviewed stellar objects with missing CNS5 RV but an existing adopted SIMBAD RV, use the complete Western position/motion bundle to retain full-space motion. Spectroscopic binaries and composite Porrima retain the nearest-catalog RV withholding. Keep positions, velocities, reference epoch, raw measurements, uncertainties and bibliographies together. Withheld individual/system velocities remain withheld.

physical.decision: Prefer the frozen 2025 spectroscopic temperature over the 1999 model temperature; retain primary-dominated spectral scope and withhold individual mass, radius, luminosity and age as in the existing reviewed catalogs.

adoptedMotion.scope: Spectroscopic binary primary/system proxy, not a fitted systemic or instantaneous component prediction. Unknown orbital contribution is not represented by a formal uncertainty.

* bet Peg.label: Scheat (Beta Pegasi)
* bet Peg.scope: Exact beta Peg / HIP 113881 photosphere; molecular shell extent is separate.
* bet Peg.note: VLTI/AMBER Rosseland radius from the near-continuum 2012 observations; bolometric luminosity from extinction-corrected flux and distance 60.09 +/-0.54 pc. Source Teff=3909 +/-187 K is retained in inputs; the existing catalog temperature remains independent. Mass is model-dependent (different initial-track ranges), so no point mass is adopted.

luminosity_solar.method: Convert published log10(L/Lsun); not a mixed-source radius/temperature derivation
